city_served.value: Served — one of the 24 South Carolina towns confirmed served (Brand Guide Section E)

local_context.value: Edisto Island lies mostly in Charleston County, with Edisto Beach (a separate town) in Colleton County; Edisto Beach (2010): 45.4% of year-round residents 65+, median age 63.3, 87.2% of 2,181 housing units rental or vacation; Hurricane Hugo spared the island in 1989. No 65+ share is published for the Edisto Island CDP itself in the sources read; the Edisto Beach figures are for the neighbouring town.

neighborhoods.value: Edisto Beach (separate town), Wyndham Oceanridge, Frogmore, Fig Island, Oak Island, Cassina Point, Botany Bay

place_entities.value: Edisto Beach State Park; Edisto Island Presbyterian Church; Edisto Island Baptist Church, Trinity Church and Botany Bay named in the Edisto Island article; no hospital on the island

permit_office.value: Charleston County Building Inspection Services (843-202-6930) issues construction permits (page confirms unincorporated county service only by reference); the Town of Edisto Beach has its own building department (843-869-2505) for property inside that town. Edisto Island parcel jurisdiction not stated on official pages
